in_sanskrit.meaning: वृन्दा (Vrinda) is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vrinda' which means 'cluster' or 'bunch'. It is also the name of a celestial nymph in Hindu mythology who is the wife of Jambavan and the mother of Sesha, the serpent king.
